_comment: Spellbook buttons rs2check rule 23 knows about: a button the 377 cache draws, with a real
action on it, that no trigger in this content can cast. Every entry is a spell the client
already offers and the server does not answer. They are declared here rather than left out
of the rule, so the rule can stay red for the NEXT one.
A key is interface:component, or interface:* for a whole interface.
magic:com_531: Tele Block, level 85. Needs a teleport-blocked timer on the target and the wilderness teleport paths to honour it. The three Teleother buttons used to sit beside this one saying the accept/decline dialogue did not exist; it did, as inter_251.if, and all three are built (2026-09-21). This one's note is the accurate kind: what it needs is a mechanism, not a panel.
inter_267:*: The REAL Ancient Magicks spellbook out of the 377 cache - Jagex's own grid, the level tooltips, the 16 combat spells and the 8 ancient teleports. The server does not use it: ancient_magic.if is a hand-built reconstruction with an invented layout, made when this file could not be found (it has no searchable word in it - see tools/interfaceindex.py). Swapping to the real one is its own round. See claude/lvl6-enchant-and-the-real-ancient-book.md.
